text:
GENERATE BURST CS-near3-limb-bottom — ELONGATED NEAR-CAMERA PINE LIMB on green for a foreground layer that must never show where the limb starts (Matt R-C3-87/95). task_id "CS-near3-limb-bottom".

IMAGE 1 is an approved in-game frame of a hand-painted 2D ARPG: the gnarled dark CLIFF-PINE BRANCH at the top-left, close to the camera, is the approved look (twisted grey-violet bark, dark blue-green needle tufts, near-silhouette with a warm sunset rim light on its upper edges, very slight softness because it is near the camera).
Paint ONE PORTRAIT image 1024×1536 on flat PURE GREEN #00ff00 containing ONE long gnarled cliff-pine limb in exactly that look: its thick base ENTERS FROM THE BOTTOM BORDER (cut flush and straight by the bottom border, as if the tree stands below the frame) near the right third, rises and leans LEFT across the upper half, thinning into twisted twigs with 5–8 needle clusters; it does NOT touch the left, right or top borders. Everything around it is flat pure #00ff00. No sky, rock, ground, characters, text or border.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the base is not cut flush with the required border, the limb touches a forbidden border, the background is not flat pure #00ff00, or the style departs from IMAGE 1 — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/near3_limb_bottom.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-near3-limb-bottom"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — approved near-camera branch look (style reference)
